findings.classification: exposed by #66 (pre-existing gap since #17; SPEC was ambiguous)
findings.status: owner decided 2026-11-27 (D-19: a carrier failure is a failed text); built in #80 (open, not merged)
findings.spec: FR-6 (email if the text fails; one channel per request, never both); hard constraint: at most 2 messages per job
findings.summary: A text Twilio accepted but later reported undelivered or failed stayed 'sent' and never fell back to email. #66 started reading these statuses but ignored them.
findings.reproduction: src/requests/delivery.test.ts 'a signed "undelivered" status sends the request by email instead' (no recordSmsFailure on main; the route acknowledged the status and left the text sent)

findings.status: fixed in #80 at the owner's request (2026-11-27)
findings.summary: A receipt that arrived before deliver() recorded the message ID matched no row and was dropped (Twilio does not retry). Now kept in pending_receipts and applied by deliver(); write-then-read on both sides, idempotent apply; unmatched rows purged after 24 h.
findings.reproduction: src/requests/requests.test.ts 'receipts that arrive before the send records the message ID (O-66-1)': the two race tests fail with the deliver() apply disabled and pass with it

findings.status: fixed in #80 at the owner's request (2026-11-27)
findings.summary: review_requests.provider_message_id had no index; every receipt scanned the table. Index added (migration 0017).
findings.reproduction: src/requests/delivery.test.ts 'looks requests up by an index on provider_message_id (O-66-2)'

findings.status: fixed in #80 at the owner's request (2026-11-27)
findings.summary: A malformed TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_URL threw in twilioConfigFromEnv, making sends, the inbound STOP webhook and confirmations answer 'not configured'. Now receipts are turned off (logged by setting name) and only /api/sms/status answers 503.
findings.reproduction: src/sms/twilio.test.ts 'turns receipts off ... (O-66-3)' (main threw) and delivery.test.ts route 503 test

findings.status: fixed in #80 at the owner's request (2026-11-27)
findings.summary: Job runs wrote ~480 audit_log rows a day that can never be deleted (append-only trigger). Now one overwritten job_runs row per job; old audit rows still read for the 7-day lookback during the transition.
findings.reproduction: src/jobs/status.test.ts 'keeps one row per job ... writing nothing to audit_log (O-62-1)'

observations: #63: failure details hold a sanitized code only (Resend name regex, Twilio numeric code, class name); one alert per location, kind and period via a prefix match on detail; offboarded businesses excluded.
#62: the route returns job names, states and times only; a run that throws inside a step is recorded as failed, so a working scheduler never reads as late.
